subject: Approval request: comp outlier + sign-on for Sr ML Engineer (Rileigh Chan)
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Approval request: comp outlier + sign-on for Sr ML Engineer (Rileigh Chan)

Hi Marcus, Michael —

We have a strong candidate for the Sr ML Engineer (role on Realtime Inference team): Rileigh Chan (ex-Greenridge). The recruiter flagged this as a rare market outlier. Current comp band for the role: base $170k–$210k + 10–15% target bonus + equity band 0.08–0.2%. Candidate asks: base $225k, 25% target bonus, and an equity refresh pool of 0.35% (sign-on equity).

Why this matters: Rileigh has heavy latency optimization experience (PerfNet), shipped 2 low-latency products at scale, and would be the early hire to lead realtime model infra. We risk losing them to 2 competing offers (one from a well-funded infra startup that already offered $230k + heavy RSU grant).

Request: approval for a one-time exception (out-of-band base to $225k) + 25% sign-on bonus (pro-rated first-year cash) OR alternatively a $50k sign-on cash and a 0.25% equity refresh grant. I've attached the benchmarking deck and the current offer draft.

Notes:
- This is a time-sensitive ask — candidate expects final numbers by Mon EOD PT.
- I recommend the equity refresh vesting schedule be 4y with 1y cliff; standard Redwood offer otherwise.

Attachments: offer_letter_RChan_v2.pdf (draft), comp-benchmarking-sr-ml.xlsx

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15 if helpful.

—Steph
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0184

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request: comp outlier + sign-on for Sr ML Engineer (Rileigh Chan)

Steph —

Thanks for the context and the benchmarking deck. High level: I understand the urgency and the strategic value. I'm comfortable approving a total OTE increase to match the market for this individual, but want to keep the equity line of sight reasonable. Proposal I can approve now: base $220k + 20% target bonus + 0.25% one-time sign-on equity (4y vest, 1y cliff). If compensation justification is stronger (specific revenue/ops impact commitments), we can flex to $225k base.

Conditions:
- Hiring manager (Michael) to add 2 measurable success metrics for Q1 that justify the premium (latency pct improvements, rollout milestones).
- Offer contingent on reference checks and a short onboarding performance plan.

Approve the above in principle — Steph, please proceed to finalize language with candidate and get formal approval from Finance for budget drawdown (cc Laura).

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP, People Operations
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:19:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request: comp outlier + sign-on for Sr ML Engineer (Rileigh Chan)

Thanks — quick clarifying note and a small ask.

Clarify: I agree Rileigh is exceptional. My preferred offer is the $220k + 20% + 0.25% equity Marcus outlined. If candidate pushes for $225k base, I'd prefer to split the delta with an additional one-time cash sign-on ($25k) rather than moving base beyond band ceilings. That keeps org comp structure tidy.

Success metrics I propose to add to the offer (first 6 months):
- Reduce 95th-percentile inference latency for Production Model-A by 18–22% over baseline within Q1.
- Deliver a plan and initial rollout for adaptive KV caching for two highest-traffic endpoints by week 16.

I will take ownership of the onboarding success plan and periodic check-ins.

—Michael
Michael Grant
Director, Realtime Inference
michael_grant@redwood.com
